name: Waseem Sial
full_role: Player Profile and Squad Research Writer
description: Waseem Sial researches CPL player profiles, squad membership, player roles and franchise roster changes.
bio: Waseem Sial works on CPL Season player profiles and squad coverage. He checks the current franchise, player role, roster category and published squad status before updating the directory.
Player photos appear when an up-to-date image is available. Other profiles use the player’s initials.
coverage_focus: Profiles, roster changes, roles and squad announcements
method: Checks every player against the current published team list.
Keeps roster category and franchise membership synchronized.
Adds a player photo only when it matches the current squad member.
